Course modification dates are set by the start of enrollment for each respective term, as a course cannot change once a student has already enrolled. Courses are reviewed by the department curriculum committees and chairs, the college curriculum committees and deans, the Faculty Senate curriculum committees, and then are voted on by the members of the Faculty Senate.
